title: Asymptotic-Preserving Particle-In-Cell Method for the Magnetized Vlasov–Poisson–Fokker–Planck Equation
summary: Asymptotic-preserving particle methods for a strongly magnetized kinetic equation, with analysis of their asymptotic properties and uniform convergence.

title: Depth splitting method for the linear Boltzmann model of primary proton distribution
summary: A deterministic solver combining scattering decomposition and depth splitting for proton transport, with dose distributions compared against Monte Carlo simulations.
note: Preprint title: A deterministic solver for the linear Boltzmann model of a single mono-directional proton beam.

title: A fully asymptotic preserving decomposed multi-group method for the frequency-dependent radiative transfer equations
summary: A decomposed multi-group method with asymptotic-preserving frequency, time, and space discretizations in different radiation diffusion limits.

title: A spatial-temporal asymptotic preserving scheme for radiation magnetohydrodynamics in the equilibrium and non-equilibrium diffusion limit
summary: A decomposition of radiative intensity yields a space-time asymptotic-preserving scheme for both equilibrium and non-equilibrium diffusion limits.

title: Accurate Front Capturing Asymptotic Preserving Scheme for Nonlinear Gray Radiative Transfer Equation
summary: A prediction-correction-projection approach that captures front propagation in the nonlinear diffusion limit while preserving the free-streaming limit.

title: Semi-implicit front capturing schemes for the degenerate nonlinear radiative diffusion equation
summary: Two semi-implicit front-capturing schemes for degenerate nonlinear radiative diffusion, examining accuracy, stability, and computational cost.
